lines.text: Many learners say: My sister is embarrassed. She will have a baby.

native.caption: Muchos dicen “My sister is embarrassed. She will have a baby.” 🙈 Aunque se parezcan, “embarrassed” significa “avergonzada”. Para “embarazada” se dice: “My sister is pregnant. She will have a baby.” ¡Escucha a Carlos y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.

en.caption: Many learners say “My sister is embarrassed. She will have a baby.” They look alike, but “embarrassed” means “avergonzada”. For “embarazada” say: “My sister is pregnant. She will have a baby.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
